meta.orientation: Door is on the east wall (opens out to the foyer). Inside: west wall = facade side, south wall = entrance side.
meta.rules: SCDF: shelter walls, door and ceiling must not be hacked, drilled or altered. Everything here is free-standing or adhesive/magnetic only.
meta.note: Sizes follow the owner's sketch; confirm interior on site before ordering a made-to-measure rack.

interior.note: Wall-face to wall-face from 250 mm shelter walls: 1350 W x 2560 L. Verify on site.

whiteboard.note: Full-length magnetic whiteboard sheet / film stuck on the door's outer (foyer/living) face. No screws. Keep it off the rubber seal and cut around the handle.

rack.type: Free-standing boltless steel rack, made to measure, white powder coat
rack.note: Top shelf (2470) is a cap, ~130 below the ceiling. No shelves below 950 so luggage and the kids' bike go underneath. Back + side tie bars at 150 mm (front left open so things roll in). Units bolted to each other, not to the walls.
